content: in september 2023 a civil case regarding matrimonial property was heard in the šiauliai district court the court decided to dissolve the marriage and awarded the car to the applicant the applicant is responsible for credit obligations in enforcement proceedings the text discusses various aspects of the case including the statutory matrimonial property regime fulfillment of obligations by spouses and liability for obligations arising from marriage the applicant requested the dissolution of the marriage retention of their married name and division of jointly owned property the defendant agrees with the application a third party objects to the dissolution and division of debts the court allowed the action and will consider the division of property and liabilities the court determined that the applicant is personally liable for their debts and must pay them the court also ordered the party in whose favor the decision was made to pay the costs of the proceedings the applicant has been granted stateguaranteed legal aid the court upheld the applicants request for a full dissolution of the marriage the car remains the personal property of the applicant who is also responsible for certain liabilities the defendant has been ordered to pay a stamp duty fee and costs of sending procedural documents
